answer: Applying one unused late day to the Week 4 assignment extends the deadline by 24 hours [syllabus.md#chunk-10]. The original due time is Monday, October 19, 2026, 1:30 PM [assignments/week04-rag-plan.md#chunk-1], so with one late day you could submit by **Tuesday, October 20, 2026, 1:30 PM**.
